_comment: Run template for synthetic-g36-vav-fleet (generated by CAMBER, no real building): eight VAV air handlers (AHU__<scenario>), each with six single-duct reheat boxes (VAV1__<scenario> .. VAV6__<scenario>), hourly, at the rules' defaults. The topology declares which boxes each air handler serves, so the rogue-zone and cohort-starvation censuses group by air handler (grouping_provenance explicit) and the RCx report links box symptoms to their air handler. Per equipment: sat_ and static_reset_effectiveness on each air handler (setpoint against the T&R trajectory its own request count implies), reheat_minimization_g36, unmet_setpoint_hours and airflow_tracking on each box (0.108, #226). Fleet rules, one finding on <fleet> that camber datasets score cannot score: the SAT and static rogue-zone censuses, the SAT and static cohort-starvation censuses, cohort_airflow compared within each air handler (group_by_topology: box sizes differ, so a building-wide comparison of mean airflow finds nothing), cohort_space_temp across all 48 boxes, and zones_heat_cool_census, which pools every box building-wide. Measured (generator version 3): AHU__not_responding's SAT reset is stuck (0.06 F of swing against an expected 10) and its static reset not responding; every other reset is effective. The SAT census names VAV1__rogue_sat (100% of its air handler's requests), the static census VAV4__rogue_static (100%) and lists VAV1__rogue_sat as overloaded (short of cooling, not a starved inlet); SAT cohort starvation names AHU__not_responding, static cohort starvation AHU__not_responding and AHU__starved; cohort_airflow flags VAV1__rogue_sat and VAV4__rogue_static, cohort_space_temp VAV1__rogue_sat and the warm boxes of AHU__not_responding and AHU__starved; reheat_minimization_g36 faults on VAV2__reheat, VAV4__reheat and VAV1-5__heat_cool; zones_heat_cool_census faults (100% of occupied hours have a zone heating while another cools, the five heat_cool boxes persistently). unmet_setpoint_hours and airflow_tracking pass every box of the healthy, near_miss and reheat air handlers and fault the boxes behind AHU__starved and AHU__not_responding (the RCx report links them to that air handler's reset findings, 6 of 6 boxes); unmet_setpoint_hours also faults VAV1__rogue_sat and warns on VAV5__heat_cool, airflow_tracking faults both rogue boxes. Run one air handler alone with the exercise variants (zone-g36-fleet--healthy and the others), each of which keeps the equipment of one scenario.
